NONE: › a request for help, especially because of danger
求助；（尤指）緊急求救（信號）

example: Within an hour of the ship transmitting an SOS (message/call), six boats had arrived and started a rescue operation.
這艘船發出緊急求救信號後不到一個小時，就有六艘船到達現場救援。
The hospital sent out an SOS for extra blood supplies.
這家醫院發出緊急求助訊息，希望獲得額外的血液供應。
